flow_summary: The interviewer struggled significantly with the patient's disorganized communication style. While it successfully navigated the intake, it frequently failed to adapt to the patient's confusion, resulting in repetitive, mechanical loops during the PHQ-9 and GAD-7 sections rather than providing necessary clarification or support.

issues.evidence: When the patient expressed confusion about the PHQ-9 and GAD-7 questions, the interviewer simply repeated the exact same list of options multiple times instead of rephrasing or offering assistance. For example: 'Please choose one response option: Not at all, Several days, More than half the days, or Nearly every day.'

The interviewer failed to acknowledge the patient's distress or confusion, instead rigidly adhering to the script. When the patient said 'Hm. Hard to say. My days all run together lately,' the interviewer ignored the emotional content and simply repeated the prompt.
The interviewer did not address the patient's disclosure of a recent overdose and current passive suicidal ideation with any acknowledgement, moving immediately to the next section of the intake.
